title: Chapter 1216
text:
This message was Jayz's last words, full of expectations.

Han Xiao glanced at the technical information in the communicator and felt a heavy weight.

This mirage of history had disappeared. Before the three Universal Civilizations figured out the mysteries of the Sanctums, the technology in his hands was the only copy. Although it was only part of the technology collected by Jayz, it was still precious.

It was not just a personal bonus but also a button to change the direction of the universe, and the initiative to press the button was in his hands.

Since this was a relay across Iterations, according to his current situation, the title of successor was not wrong. This technical information had already given him the qualifications to pry open the structure of the universe, and the change in the development path of the Universal Civilizations was within his thoughts.

If he chose to take on such a mission, then what to do with this technical information would become a problem.

"… No matter what, everything has to wait until I finish the research."

Han Xiao pondered.

With so much technical information, a considerable portion of it was beneficial to the development of the civilization. It would be a waste to keep it like a treasure. The final destination would definitely be the galactic society, contributing to the universe and improving the lives of all galactic residents.

However, with his personality, it was impossible for him to contribute for free. He would either develop it himself and sell it, or use a portion of the technology to exchange for some resources from the three Universal Civilizations. No matter which option he chose, his own position and the strength of the Black Star Army would rise to a whole new level, reaching a level that no one had ever reached before. They would become transcendent.

However, these things had to wait until he thoroughly studied all the technical information. It was still too early.

As for Jayz's request, Han Xiao had not decided whether to agree or not. It was more appropriate to wait and see when the time came.

These thoughts only flashed through his mind, and the collapse of this world continued. The situation was no different from the decay of the other secondary dimensions.

The speed at which this secondary dimension decomposed was getting faster and faster, and the range of the chain reaction expanded exponentially. Energy was expanding and overflowing, space was being pulled and torn apart, and starlight dimmed one after another, replaced by strange light spots. This was the external manifestation of the thinning of the space wall.

Then, these light spots suddenly cracked open, turning into holes in the space wall. The space turbulence outside instantly poured in, and blue space energy storms wreaked havoc, accelerating the decay of the dimension.

"Let's go!"

Seeing this, Kasuyi's eyes lit up and he flew out of the hole in the Space Wall without hesitation. Han Xiao did not stop him and followed closely behind.

The two of them returned to the spatial storm of the secondary dimension world. Immediately, their spirits were lifted, and they felt the pressure on their bodies disappear. Every breath they took was fresh and refreshing.

"I'm finally out."

Sensing the connection to the Void Dimension again, Kasuyi finally breathed a sigh of relief. He quickly replenished his energy in one breath, and only then did he feel at ease.

The two of them turned their heads from the outside and saw that the seemingly endless secondary dimension when they first arrived was collapsing inwards like a deflated balloon.

Under the gazes of the two, this secondary dimension was torn apart by the space turbulence and rapidly disintegrated. Rainbow-Like energy gushed out and merged into the space storm.

Suddenly, Kasuyi's eyes moved. He released his mental force in a certain direction and retrieved a few pieces of origin energy fragments when the dimension was dying. A smile immediately appeared on his face.

Han Xiao glanced at him. "Have you found the opportunity for your transformation?"

"Yes, I'm not mistaken. My senses are pointing to the origin energy fragments of this dimension. I have vaguely felt the entry point to the next level of God's Trait Transformation. As long as I go back and ponder for a while, I will definitely be able to enter the next stage. This is all thanks to your help."

Kasuyi was satisfied.

He was now extremely glad that he had chosen Han Xiao as his teammate. If it had been anyone else, this trip would have been a near death experience. However, bringing along Han Xiao was a daunting experience without any danger.

Although this person was shameless, he was too reliable!

"Congratulations, congratulations." Han Xiao said a few polite words, then pointed to the origin energy fragments. "Everyone has a share. How about you give me one?"

"Hey, you're really thick-skinned. You took all of Jayz's technical information for yourself, and now you dare to say that everyone has a share."

With a look of disgust, Kasuyi casually threw a piece of origin energy fragment to Han Xiao.

He was in a good mood now and was too lazy to care about this. Anyway, his senses told him that he only needed one fragment. If not for Black Star, this trip would not have gone so smoothly, so he was not stingy with his dividends.

Receiving the fragment, Han Xiao played with it for a while. Then, he glanced at the item introduction and could not help but shake his head.

This secondary dimension was very special, but there was nothing special about the origin energy fragments. It was impossible to cultivate a similar cycle of spacetime. This was a unique Space Wonder in itself.

Neither of them left immediately. Instead, they stayed in place and watched as this dimension completely disappeared without a trace, completely assimilated into the space turbulence.

The second round of [Relay Across Iterations] has been completed!

You have received 1,500,000,000 EXP, 1 Random Reward, and [Character Summon Card – Jayz].

"It's a R&D type ability …"

Han Xiao nodded.

Jayz's R&D ability was unquestionable. The Heaven Shrouding Apparatus and a bunch of targeted technologies were the best examples. Han Xiao had a lot of combat ability Character Summon Cards in his hands, and now, he wanted to obtain abilities for other purposes. This Character Summon Card met his needs.

He looked down and found that the mission notification was not over yet.

Third round activated!

Third Round Mission Requirements: Successfully enter at least one Sanctum and establish communication.

Reward: 2,000,000,000 EXP, 2 Random Rewards, 3 corresponding Sanctum fragments, and the next round of the mission activated.

"The next round's requirement is a Sanctum …"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes slightly.

According to Jayz, the Sanctums stored information from many Iterations, but it was not a public library that anyone could read. Be it an individual or a civilization, they had to complete some kind of communication to obtain information from it.

Oathkeeper had said that there were a total of six Sanctums. He did not know if different Sanctums had different communication methods, but Oathkeeper had not returned after so long, so it was probably not a simple matter.

There were also Sanctum fragments in the reward. He had several [The First Sanctum] fragments in his hands. Han Xiao originally thought that it was the qualification to enter the Sanctum, but it seemed that was not the case.

After learning so many secrets on this trip, Han Xiao had already made up his mind. Even if there was no mission, he would still go to the Sanctums. This mission was an unexpected reward.

The other mission [Kasuyi's Invitation] was also completed at the same time. He received 4,500,000,000 EXP, six Random Rewards, and three Character Summon Cards.

The Character Summon Cards were all Kasuyi's, but their abilities were different. One was a mental defense, one was a Void talent, and the last one was [The Ancient Ones], which had an amazing drop rate.

Kasuyi's Favorability increased by 30 points, which was a huge increase. He had obtained a God's Trait Transformation opportunity, and Han Xiao himself had also obtained one God's Trait Transformation Point. At the same time, he had also obtained a new milestone [Witness of the Old Era]. Its introduction was that his experience had become richer, and his Intelligence and MYS had increased by 3%.

"The effect is very versatile. It can be considered a professional match. It's slightly useful …"

Han Xiao thought to himself.

Just as he was browsing through the mission rewards, Kasuyi's question suddenly sounded in his mind, and he had mixed feelings.

"What are you going to do next?"

Turning around, he saw that Kasuyi's expression was rather complicated.

Witnessing the disappearance of the last Iteration of the universe in front of his eyes, Kasuyi felt both emotional and regretful. He only felt that this adventure was like a dream.

Han Xiao knew what Kasuyi was asking. He shook his head and said, "I'll keep these technologies and do my own research first. Now is not the time to expose these secrets."

"That's right. The Iteration of the universe is still too far away from us. That's something the three Universal Civilizations should consider. Although a Beyond Grade A is a powerful individual, it's still very insignificant in this situation." Kasuyi sighed and said, "Anyway, the technical information is in your hands. You have the initiative. What you do is your business, and it has nothing to do with me."

Han Xiao raised his brows and did not say anything, only staring at him with shining eyes.

Sensing Han Xiao's meaningful gaze, Kasuyi understood the meaning behind this gaze and laughed.

"Don't worry. Although I'm also an insider, I won't ask for trouble. Once this information is revealed to outsiders, I won't be able to stay out of it, and you'll come looking for me … You also don't have to worry about me reporting to the Arcane Church. I'm not familiar with them."

During this joint operation, Kasuyi had once again refreshed his judgment of Han Xiao's strength. He was shocked, so he did not want to fall out with Han Xiao at all.

Only the two of them knew about this information. If it was leaked, Black Star would immediately know that it was him who did it. In his opinion, it was better to avoid trouble. Unlike Old Manison, who wanted to make big news, Kasuyi preferred to stay out of trouble.

Furthermore, he was not a direct descendant of the Arcane Church, so he had no intention of reporting it. If he was so loyal to Ethereal, he would not have gone easy on them during the rescue of Hella.

Han Xiao nodded, changed the topic, and frowned.

"You've seen the situation of the Beyond Grade As under the rule of the Celestial Star Alliance. The Sanctums are our lifeline and cannot be monopolized by the advanced civilizations. Otherwise, we'll repeat the same mistake."

Hearing this, Kasuyi's expression also became serious.

With this experience, he had deeply realized that the Beyond Grade As were bound together for good or ill, so he was very concerned about this issue.

"You're right. The three Universal Civilizations will research to this point sooner or later. Since we know the significance of the Sanctums in advance, we should plan ahead."

Han Xiao pondered and said, "In order to avoid becoming like the Celestial Star Alliance, we Beyond Grade As have to take control of the Sanctums ourselves. Fortunately, we've already established a Beyond Grade A association. Individuals are unreliable, and only the association is qualified to take on this responsibility. This way, the future Beyond Grade As will not need to give up their freedom and beg the advanced civilizations for mercy."

"You did have foresight when you promoted the establishment of the association back then." Kasuyi agreed.

I didn't expect that the association would be of such great use to me either … Han Xiao grinned to himself.

"Ahem, in short, I have some clues about the Sanctums in my hands. After some time, I'll start investigating."

"If there's anything you need help with, just let me know," Kasuyi said.

If it was like the Celestial Star Alliance, it would have been too late for the Beyond Grade As to unite after the advanced civilizations had mastered the Sanctums. On the path of civilization development, many opportunities only came once. If they missed it, they would just miss it.

In this regard, neither of them was selfish. The Sanctums were the lifeline of the Beyond Grade As, and monopolizing them would make them the enemy of all the Beyond Grade As in the entire universe.

Only when the association took on this important mission would it be accepted by everyone. In this way, the nature of the association would become extremely important. The alliance between the members would be unbreakable and extremely united, and it would not disintegrate because of internal reasons.

Currently, only the two of them knew about this, and they both had the same goal. With this bond, it was equivalent to forming a secret alliance. For Han Xiao, the benefit was that Kasuyi, who had always been neutral, was now leaning toward his faction, and his influence in the association would increase by another level.

Although the two of them had reached a tacit agreement not to reveal what they had seen for the time being, they both knew that some things had quietly changed.

Based on this information, they had formulated a new plan, which would inevitably cause an indirect butterfly effect. Unless the two of them pretended that nothing had happened, the scope of the influence would only increase, and sooner or later, it would affect the entire universe.

With the matter settled, the two of them were about to leave when they suddenly sensed something. They turned around and saw a large group of Space Lice wandering aimlessly.

"Yo, it's been a few months, and these little cuties still haven't left."

Han Xiao's eyes lit up, and he immediately recalled the idea of breeding Space Lice.

Kasuyi had completed the God's Trait Transformation mission, and now that he was free, he also had some thoughts. "I'll bring some specialties back on the way back. I'll catch a batch and raise them in the Void Dimension."

The two of them looked at each other and smiled. The atmosphere around them was similar.
